# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4 rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with GPU-backed GTK4 views and restored Linux system-font discovery. This preview also aligns WebAssembly native assets with .NET 11 and moves Tizen packages to Tizen 10. GTK4 applications gain explicit control over physical-pixel and logical-coordinate painting.

## Breaking Changes

- **Choose GTK4 painting coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates while preserving full-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo remains physical, and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Move Tizen applications to Tizen 10** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and require Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64; Tizen 8/9 and 32-bit native builds are no longer supported. Update application targets and deployment requirements. Building the native libraries requires the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding managed APIs or native entry points. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.100 package revision accompanies the milestone; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **GPU-backed GTK4 canvas** — SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext and an opt-in render loop using GTK's GL context. QueueRender requests a repaint. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, GTK's GL dispatcher. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — The default font manager discovers installed fonts without fontconfig again, using /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at native build time. This restores family lookup and prevents SKShaper construction failures caused by empty typefaces when fonts are installed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **GTK4 raster buffer lifetime corrected** — The raster view releases its Skia surface before Cairo's backing pixel storage and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Platform

- **Matching WebAssembly assets for .NET 11** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. net8 retains 3.1.34; net9 and net10 retain 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## Security

- **Consistent Windows native hardening** — Windows native builds use matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries, and ANGLE propagates control-flow guard and stack-cookie flags to eligible third-party code. Spectre CRT provenance does not imply whole-program Spectre mitigation. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp aligns WebAssembly archive selection with .NET 11, moves Tizen native packages to Tizen 10, and uses matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries in Windows native builds. These changes do not upgrade the native HarfBuzz engine.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and moves Tizen packages to Tizen 10.
